name: conditionString
label: Query
description: Encoded query string for filtering targets.

name: showTabs
label: Show tabs
description: Select to show the tabs selector for target type

name: type
label: Default tab
description: Sets whether to show Global targets, Personal targets, or both by default.

name: showFilters
label: Show filters button
description: Select to show the filters button

name: showCurrentTarget
label: Show current
description: Select to show current target in the list

name: showPastTargets
label: Show past
description: Select to show past targets in the list by default

name: showFutureTargets
label: Show future
description: Select to show future targets in the list

name: showIndicatorName
label: Show indicator name
description: Select to show indicator name for target

name: showTargetStatus
label: Show target status
description: Select to show status for target

name: targetCreationSource
label: Target creation source
description: Choose how to specify the indicator for the target

name: uuid
label: Target UUID
description: The UUID of the fully specified indicator to which you are applying the target you are creating. Required if create target is enabled. For example, indicatorSysId:breakdownSysId:breakdownElementSysId

name: indicatorsList
label: KPI List
description: List of indicators with id and label to show in KPI Picker. For example, [{'id': '123', 'label': 'KPI Name'}]

name: breakdownElementInfo
label: Breakdowns : elements
description: Colon-separated sysIds of breakdowns and elements for constructing uuid during target creation. For example, `breakdown1SysId:element1SysId:breakdown2SysId:element2SysId`. Please note that you cannot have more than 2 breakdowns.

name: baselineConfigOptions
label: Baseline config options
description: Allow user to base a new target on a change to the old target or a change to the average score. If neither option is available or selected, the new target is an entered value. Pass an empty array or one or both of ["averageScore", "previousTarget"], case-sensitive, in that order

name: averageScore
label: Average score
description: Average score to be used as a baseline for improvement targets

name: additionalBaselineFilter
label: Additional baseline filter
description: Function provided by the user to filter baseline values used in target calculation. For example, `(item) => { return item.value > 10;}`

name: noTargetMsg
label: No target custom message
description: Custom message to be shown when there are no targets available. Default message is - No targets are created yet

name: enableEdit
label: Enable editing
description: Select to allow users to edit the target value on click.
